parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: because I want to buy some chicken
the desk is in the middle?
I had a very bad dream.
to refuse a poor man money.

parts.text: That artist painted many pictures of bridges. I must reach the shop before it closes because I want to buy some chicken for lunch tomorrow. He feels much stronger today; yesterday he was very weak. Some people are willing to die for what they believe. Are you sure the desk is in the middle? Last night I had a very bad dream. It is a crime to refuse a poor man money.
